description: Test keyboard events live: press any key to see its key, code, keyCode, location and modifiers, with a full event history log.

faqs.a: key is the character produced (affected by layout and modifiers), while code is the physical key position (e.g. KeyA) — code stays the same across layouts.
faqs.q: What is the difference between key and code?

faqs.a: keyCode is a legacy numeric code (e.g. 13 for Enter). Prefer key and code in new code; keyCode is shown here for debugging older scripts.
Yes — tick preventDefault to stop the browser's default action, e.g. to test that Space does not scroll the page.
faqs.q: Can I prevent default browser shortcuts?

faqs.a: Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.

howto: Click inside the test box to focus it.
Press any keys — key, code, keyCode, location and modifiers appear live.
Review the history table or clear it to start over.
title: Keyboard Event Tester
